text: A Psalm of David (beloved). 1 The earth is the LORD’s {YHWH}, and the fullness thereof <1Co 10:26>, the world and all who dwell therein.
For He has founded it upon the seas and established it upon the waters.
Who may ascend the hill of the LORD {YHWH}? Who may stand in His holy place?
He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol (to falsehood) or swear deceitfully.
He will receive blessing from the LORD {YHWH} and vindication from the God {Elohe} of his salvation.
Such is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek Your face, O God of Jacob [who seek your face, O Jacob]. Selah
Lift up your⁺ heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!
Who is this King of Glory? The LORD {YHWH} strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
Lift up your⁺ heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!
Who is He, this King of Glory? The LORD {YHWH} of Hosts—He is the King of Glory. Selah
